title: Mcedia China Media Platforms Resolver
description: Provides media extraction support for Chinese streaming platforms such as Bilibili and Douyin.
body:
Mcedia China Media Platforms Resolver 是 Mcedia 的平台扩展模组，用于让 Mcedia 解析并播放部分中文内容平台的媒体链接。

目前，这个模组主要提供以下功能：

- 支持解析 Bilibili 普通视频链接
- 支持解析 Bilibili 番剧链接
- 支持解析 Bilibili 直播间链接
- 支持解析 Douyin（抖音）视频分享链接
- 自动提取可播放的媒体流，并交给 Mcedia 播放
- 为 Bilibili 视频/番剧提供弹幕加载支持
- 提供 Bilibili 账号二维码登录命令，用于在本地保存登录 Cookie，以便访问部分需要登录状态的内容

例如：
- https://live.bilibili.com/8604981
- 【《赢》：献给正在“折腾”的年轻人-哔哩哔哩】 https://b23.tv/Iq2OE0n
- https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep249496?spm_id_from=333.337.0.0&from_spmid=666.25.episode.0
- 【猫和老鼠 旧版：第28话 杰瑞如此执拗 Jerry, Jerry, Quite Contrary】 https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep249496/?share_source=copy_web
- 【《猫和老鼠 旧版》 第1话 飞翔猫 The Flying Cat-哔哩哔哩番剧】https://b23.tv/ep249469
- 3.05 2026抖音新春特别会 # 抖音新春特别会  https://v.douyin.com/5rKbxbpmxGQ/ 复制此链接，打开抖音搜索，直接观看视频！ :2pm 05/02 Fus:/ d@a.Ag 

这个模组会把支持的平台链接转换为 Mcedia 可播放的媒体信息，包括标题、作者/UP 主、封面以及实际播放流地址。
对于 Bilibili 视频，模组还会尝试提取分 P 信息，并为弹幕系统附带对应的元数据。
对于 Bilibili 直播，模组会检查直播间是否正在开播，并获取可播放的直播流。
对于 Douyin 视频，模组会解析分享链接并提取实际视频地址。

客户端还提供了以下 Bilibili 相关命令：

- /mcedia platforms bilibili login
- /mcedia platforms bilibili account
- /mcedia platforms bilibili logout

这些命令可用于登录、查看当前账号状态以及清除本地登录信息。

注意：
- 这是 Mcedia 的扩展模组，并不是独立播放器。
- 实际可播放性取决于目标平台返回的媒体地址、登录状态以及平台接口变化。
- 某些 Bilibili 内容可能需要本地登录 Cookie 才能正常解析或播放。

---

cn-platforms is a platform extension for Mcedia that adds support for resolving and playing media links from several Chinese content platforms.

At the moment, this mod mainly provides the following features:

- Resolve Bilibili regular video links
- Resolve Bilibili bangumi / episode links
- Resolve Bilibili live room links
- Resolve Douyin video share links
- Extract playable media streams and pass them to Mcedia for playback
- Load danmaku for Bilibili videos and bangumi
- Provide Bilibili QR-code login commands so a local login cookie can be stored for content that may require an authenticated session

e.g.:
- https://live.bilibili.com/8604981
- 【《赢》：献给正在“折腾”的年轻人-哔哩哔哩】 https://b23.tv/Iq2OE0n
- https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep249496?spm_id_from=333.337.0.0&from_spmid=666.25.episode.0
- 【猫和老鼠 旧版：第28话 杰瑞如此执拗 Jerry, Jerry, Quite Contrary】 https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep249496/?share_source=copy_web
- 【《猫和老鼠 旧版》 第1话 飞翔猫 The Flying Cat-哔哩哔哩番剧】https://b23.tv/ep249469

This mod converts supported platform links into media data that Mcedia can use, including title, author/uploader, cover image, and the actual playback stream URL.
For Bilibili videos, it also handles multi-part pages when available and attaches metadata used by the danmaku system.
For Bilibili live streams, it checks whether the room is currently live and then fetches a playable live stream URL.
For Douyin videos, it resolves the share link and extracts the final video URL.

The client also includes the following Bilibili-related commands:

- /mcedia platforms bilibili login
- /mcedia platforms bilibili account
- /mcedia platforms bilibili logout

These commands can be used to log in, check the current account status, and clear locally stored login data.

Notes:
- This is an extension for Mcedia, not a standalone media player.
- Playback depends on the target platform’s returned stream URLs, login state, and any upstream API changes.
- Some Bilibili content may require a local login cookie to resolve or play correctly.
